company.shortDescription: Newsreels is a digital news platform that delivers current events through short, reel-style vertical videos.
company.description: Newsreels aims to modernize how people consume news by combining elements of social media video formats with traditional journalism. The app provides a personalized feed of short news clips based on a user’s interests, covering topics such as politics, business, entertainment, sports, technology, and global events.
